data.long_description:
Experience refined living in this elegant 2-bedroom apartment at Akala Residences, part of the prestigious Akala Hotels and Residences development.

Spanning 1,556.78 sq ft, this beautifully designed home offers generous living spaces, modern finishes, and a seamless blend of comfort and sophistication, making it ideal for both end-users and investors. The layout is thoughtfully planned to maximize space and natural light, creating a bright and inviting atmosphere throughout.

The apartment features a spacious living and dining area, complemented by contemporary interiors and high-quality finishes. Both bedrooms are well-sized, offering comfort and privacy, while the overall design reflects a modern and elegant lifestyle.

Property Highlights:
2 Spacious Bedrooms
Size 1,556.78 sq ft
Expansive and functional layout
High-end finishes and contemporary design
Bright living and dining area
Premium branded residence

Why Akala Residences:
Enjoy a lifestyle defined by luxury, convenience, and world-class hospitality within a branded residence setting. Residents benefit from upscale amenities, premium services, and a prime location, making it an excellent choice for modern urban living.
